Alphanumeric series: 5 6 ! @ 5 B C 8 N # P 4 > K < G & H * ? 9 1 A R % 3. Step 1: arrange original numbers in increasing order immediately after >. Step 2: arrange original letters in reverse alphabetical order immediately after #. Step 3: reverse the Step 2 result.
Q1. In Step 3, what is third to the right of the element eighteenth to the left of #?
questions.explanation: Step 3 is % ? * & < 9 8 6 5 5 4 3 1 > A B C G H K N P R # @ !. The 18th element left of # is 9; three to its right is 5.
questions.source: Alphabets 01  Class Notes.pdf, physical p. 5, Q1; transformation group

Q3. Which element is fifth to the left of 1 in Step 1?
questions.explanation: Step 1 places the sorted numbers after >. Counting five positions left of 1 in the resulting sequence reaches C.
questions.source: Alphabets 01  Class Notes.pdf, physical p. 7, Q3; transformation group

Q10. Which is the fourteenth element from the right end after Step 3?
questions.explanation: The final sequence is 4 G U B Z P K @ 5 U % 1 ~ > * # N $ 3 5 7 8 H C W Y M ? 2. Counting from the right, the fourteenth element is #.
